result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with multiple travel lanes and embedded trolley tracks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like marked crosswalks and signals are present, the long crossing distance and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles increase risk.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and create a tripping hazard or catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant duration while crossing multiple lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Main intersection crossing

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: This signalized intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. The presence of trolley tracks and wide, unmarked pavement areas creates a hazardous environment for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected space to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The absence of pedestrian-specific signal heads forces walkers to rely on vehicular lights, which may not provide sufficient crossing time.
hazards.location_in_image: On traffic signal poles at the corners

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks and Poor Pavement
hazards.description: Embedded tracks and cracked pavement create uneven surfaces that are tripping hazards and can be slippery when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: In the center of the roadway and foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. The environment is dominated by vehicle traffic with wide lanes and on-street parking that may obstruct sight lines at the corners.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner on the right side obstruct the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the corner

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal mast arms

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, but the environment is degraded. Faded pavement markings and physical obstructions on the sidewalk, such as utility poles and trash bins, reduce the overall safety and accessibility of the crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole and a trash bin are positioned on the corner, narrowing the effective width of the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground corner

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven sidewalk surfaces present potential tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk area in the left foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.
